key_provisions_or_claims: Shift focus from polarized promises and dangers to the realm of uncertainties.
Replace Human-Robot Interaction framing with 'Robot Embedded in a Network' (REN).
Move from general normative frameworks to context-of-use ethics grounded in the ethics of care.
Organise participatory processes and monitor care relations through public engagement and institutional change.
Adopt progressive, reversible 'measured action' to make fears and hopes commensurable.
annotation.summary_en: Open Forum paper proposing "Caring in the In-Between", an ethical-political approach to introduce responsible AI and care robots in healthcare. Drawing on STS and empirical work in a Barcelona children's hospital, it advocates focusing on uncertainty, viewing robots as embedded in networks, context-based care ethics, participatory processes and reversible measured action.
annotation.title_clean: Caring in the in-between: a proposal to introduce responsible AI and robotics to healthcare
